result.stdout:
USAGE:
    packata [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    contract          Validate and inspect contract documents                   
    data              Read data bound to contract assets                        
    infer <SOURCE>    Infer a bound CSV or database schema; compatibility alias 
                      for schema infer                                          
    schema            Infer resource structure from contract asset bindings     
    config            User settings: connectors.offline (false; downloads only),
                      connectors.store (per-user; DUBURL_PROVIDER_STORE         
                      overrides), connectors.catalog (bundled),                 
                      connectors.preferred.<scheme>. PACKATA_CONFIG_HOME        
                      overrides the user config directory                       
    connector         Discover and prepare curated database connectors using    
                      shared user configuration
